title: Tank level control
description: Keeps a tank's level between start_level and stop_level with a fill pump, and stops the pump at the high level switch. The level and the switch come from the field: a level transmitter and a switch written over Modbus by a remote I/O module or a link, or by a simulator such as Factory I/O while testing.

tags.name: start_level
tags.description: Pump starts at or below this level (%)

tags.name: stop_level
tags.description: Pump stops at or above this level (%)

tags.name: level
tags.description: Tank level (%) from the level transmitter (written by a remote I/O module, a link or a simulator)
